spec.description: SIPI IIIF media server, driven by SIPI's OpenTelemetry (OTLP) metrics (service_name=sipi). Latency, throughput, caching, decode-memory and pool saturation, rate limiting, errors, plus the dsp-api /admin/files permission route SIPI calls on every request. The legacy Prometheus scrape (service DSP_iiif_iiif) is intentionally excluded.

spec.title: Environment
spec.description: OTLP deployment.environment.name for the selected environment.

spec.title: SIPI Version
spec.description: service.version from the OTLP resource (attached to all spans and metrics), most recently reported.

spec.title: 5xx Rate
spec.description: Server-error responses per second (HTTP 5xx).

spec.title: Request Rate
spec.description: Scoped to the primary VRE host dasch-vre-$environment-01.

spec.title: Auth route request rate by status (/admin/files)
spec.description: dsp-api permission check SIPI calls on every IIIF request. 4xx = auth denials, 5xx = errors.

spec.title: Auth route avg latency (/admin/files)
spec.description: Average latency of the dsp-api permission check (rate of sum / rate of count). No histogram buckets are exported for this route, so percentiles are unavailable.

spec.title: Decode Memory Admission (rate)
spec.description: Admission-control decisions on the decode-memory budget.

spec.title: Worker Pool Permits (in use vs total)
Worker Pool Waiting
spec.description: Requests queued waiting for a worker permit.

spec.title: Pool Load-Shed & Queue Timeout (rate)
spec.description: Overload signals: requests shed or timed out waiting for a worker.

spec.title: Rate Limit: Clients Tracked
spec.description: Active client entries in the rate limiter.

spec.title: Errors (rate)
spec.description: Image-too-large rejections, memory allocation failures, and client disconnects. (essentials hash mismatch and rejected connections are not exported over OTLP.)

spec.title: SIPI Container CPU Usage
spec.description: cAdvisor container metrics for the SIPI container (service DSP_iiif_iiif).

spec.title: SIPI Container Memory Usage
spec.description: cAdvisor container metrics for the SIPI container (service DSP_iiif_iiif).

options.content: The panels below query SIPI instruments that currently return **no series over OTLP** (`service_name="sipi"`). Either the instrument is not bridged from the C++ engine to the Rust OTLP path, or it only emits under specific conditions (e.g. non-zero decode estimates). Use this row to spot gaps and decide what still needs to be bridged. If a panel here starts showing data, move it into the relevant section above.

spec.title: Decode Memory Estimate (p95)
spec.description: sipi_decode_memory_estimate_bytes. Histogram buckets are skipped when the estimate is 0, so this stays empty until non-zero decode estimates are recorded.

spec.title: Rejected Connections (rate)
spec.description: sipi_rejected_connections_total. Not bridged to OTLP (always zero on the FFI serve path). Use Pool Waiting / Load-Shed instead.

spec.title: Waiting Connections
spec.description: sipi_waiting_connections. Not bridged to OTLP. Use sipi.pool.waiting instead.

spec.title: Rate Limit Decisions by action (rate)
spec.description: sipi_rate_limit_decisions_total{action}. Legacy single-family counter; the OTLP path splits this into allowed / rejected / near_limit / shadow_rejected instead.

spec.title: Essentials Hash Mismatch (rate)
spec.description: sipi_essentials_hash_mismatch_total. Not bridged to OTLP today (C++/Prometheus-only integrity tripwire).

spec.title: Read-shape Fast Path (rate)
spec.description: sipi_read_shape_fast_path_total{format,outcome}. Not bridged to OTLP today (C++/Prometheus-only).
